text: 金十数据8月19日讯，近期，多地证监局都陆续向辖区内私募管理人发送了自查通知，信息披露真实性、风险控制等成为自查关键内容。与此同时，近日有业内人士透露，中国证券投资基金业协会向部分私募证券投资基金管理人下发专项通知，要求对特定基金净值表现开展自查。业内人士表示，8月1日《私募证券投资基金运作指引》过渡期届满，私募管理人需根据运作指引进一步提升合规意识，优化合规体系，方能实现长期发展。
text_en: Jin10 Data August 19 - Recently, multiple local CSRC bureaus have issued self-inspection notices to private fund managers in their regions, with information disclosure accuracy and risk control as key focus areas. Separately, industry sources said the Asset Management Association of China has sent special notices to some private securities fund managers requiring self-inspections of specific fund net value performance. With the transition period for the Private Securities Investment Fund Operating Guidelines ending on August 1, managers need to enhance compliance awareness and systems for long-term development.
